newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' 10-yr bond coupon rate at 14.125 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' 10-yr bond coupon rate at 14.125 pct.

text.p: The coupon rate of the Philippines' 10-year Treasury bond fell to 14.125 percent at an auction on Tuesday from the previous 16.0 percent, the Bureau of Treasury said.
it was only the second auction of the 10-year bond, following the maiden offering on September 24 last year.
Tuesday's coupon rate was close to the 14.0 percent coupon for the latest seven-year Treasury bond auction on December 17.
Bids amounting to 5.0 billion pesos were accepted by the auction committee, out of the 13.724 billion pesos tendered by banks.
Accepted rates ranged from 13.5 to 14.20 percent, with the average rate at 14.022 percent.
